title: A Veil for the Salt
author: Lena Halloran
blurb: Noor Oyelaran, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
